comment: Hand-maintained plus swept. An entry belongs here ONLY after somebody drove the stock UEFN editor MCP against that mount and watched the result. 'status': verified = the editor answered for this path; missing = find_assets returned nothing, so the mount is not exposed in the content browser at all. 'verified' verbs: find = find_assets(folder_path) returned rows; capture = CaptureAssetImage rendered a TEXTURED image (a grey render is recorded as find-only with a note); place = add_to_scene_from_asset spawned an actor; resolve = a PPID placement auto-resolved to its creative prop BP. 'placementProbed': 'failed' records a mount where placing a known asset was tried and refused - a missing mount blocks placement as well as search. A mount absent from this file is reported unverified, which is the honest default - the dump can prove a path exists in the archive, never that UEFN will accept it.
